lines.en: label chikadorm10:
: Chika, are you home?
lines.zh: : Chika，你在家吗？

lines.en: : Sensei? Is that you?
lines.zh: : Sensei？是你吗？

lines.en: : Have other men with similar voices been visiting your room lately?
lines.zh: : 最近有其他声音差不多的男人来过你房间吗？

lines.en: : Hold on a sec, I’m not wearing any-
lines.zh: : 等一下，我还没穿——

lines.en: : Ahh, whatever. Just come in.
lines.zh: : 啊，算了。进来吧。

lines.en: scene black
I open the door quicker than normal after registering the whole “not wearing any [[blank]” thing.
lines.zh: 听懂那句「还没穿[某样东西]」之后，我开门的速度比平常快了不少。

lines.en: Normally, that phrase isn't succeeded by “Ahh, whatever,” which makes me a bit skeptical, but I'm not about to question that when I know Chika is just a few feet away not wearing something.
lines.zh: 通常那句话后面不会跟着一句「啊，算了」，这让我有点起疑，但一想到 Chika 就在几步开外、身上还少穿了点什么，我就不打算追问了。

lines.en: scene chikapjs1
: Hey. You're here late today.
lines.zh: : 嘿。你今天来得挺晚。

lines.en: : And you don't have any pants on.
lines.zh: : 而你没穿裤子。

lines.en: scene chikapjs2
: Yeaahhh...Is that okay? I was gonna put some on when I realized it was you, but I just got out of the shower and I’m a little too comfortable right now, sooo...
lines.zh: : 是——啊……不行吗？我听出是你本来想穿上的，但我刚洗完澡，现在舒坦得不想动，所以嘛……

lines.en: : I'm fine with it if you are. I just expected you to be a little more...on edge or something.
lines.zh: : 你不在意我就没问题。我只是以为你会更……紧张一点什么的。

lines.en: scene chikapjs3
: Hmm...well, maybe if you took your pants off as well, we could even out the playing field and both be on edge!
lines.zh: : 嗯……那，要是你也把裤子脱了，我们就能扯平，两个人一起紧张了！

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: I reach for my belt and-
lines.zh: 我伸手去解皮带——

lines.en: scene chikapjs4
: Woah! Wait a second, Sensei! I was obviously kidding! You can’t take your pants off in here!
lines.zh: : 哇！等一下，Sensei！我明显是在开玩笑！你不能在这儿脱裤子！

lines.en: : I can't?
lines.zh: : 不能？

lines.en: : No!
lines.zh: : 不能！

lines.en: : I don't understand that at all.
lines.zh: : 我完全无法理解。

lines.en: : This is my room! Only I'm allowed to be pantsless! And obviously Yumi, but she's not here yet! But she could be! Which is why you have to keep your pants on!
lines.zh: : 这是我的房间！只有我可以不穿裤子！当然 Yumi 也可以，但她还没回来！但她随时可能回来！所以你必须穿着裤子！

lines.en: : I feel like the amount of trouble we'd get into with her really doesn't change much based on how many of us aren't wearing pants. We'd be screwed by any combination of that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们会被她抓包成什么样，跟我们几个人没穿裤子其实关系不大。不管怎么组合，我们都要完蛋。

lines.en: : Exactly! And we can't even play the boyfriend/girlfriend card because...well, we aren't boyfriend and girlfriend!
lines.zh: : 就是啊！而且我们还不能用男女朋友那套说辞，因为……呃，我们又不是男女朋友！

lines.en: I sigh to myself and accept that my pants will have to remain on tonight.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，接受今晚裤子必须穿着这个事实。

lines.en: Life is unfair.
lines.zh: 人生就是这么不公平。

lines.en: scene chikapjs4r
: Jeez...if I knew you were gonna be in perv-mode tonight, I would've just bit the bullet and put on pants after all.
lines.zh: : 天哪……早知道你今晚会是变态模式，我刚才就该咬咬牙把裤子穿上。

lines.en: : Forgive me for not being able to properly contain myself around a bottomless, cute girl.
lines.zh: : 原谅我吧，面对一个没穿裤子的可爱女孩，我实在把持不住。

lines.en: scene chikapjs2
: You’re gonna have to, Sensei. We can't start doing stuff like that until we've gone on a few dates first.
lines.zh: : 你必须忍住，Sensei。在我们约会几次之前，不能开始做那种事。

lines.en: : How many dates do you think we can fit in before Yumi comes home?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Yumi 回来之前，我们能挤出几次约会？

lines.en: : Zero. But we can watch TV or something and that's like, kind of a date by modern standards.
lines.zh: : 零次。但我们可以看看电视什么的，按现代标准那也算半个约会了。

lines.en: : Is pantsless Chika really inviting me onto the bed in her current state?
lines.zh: : 没穿裤子的 Chika 真打算以她现在这副样子邀请我上床？

lines.en: scene chikapjs5
: Pantsless Chika is inviting you onto the bed for a night of wholesome bonding that may or may not lead to a small dose of cuddling if you play your cards right.
lines.zh: : 没穿裤子的 Chika 是邀请你上床，共度一个健康纯洁的亲近之夜——如果你表现好的话，最后可能会有那么一点拥抱。

lines.en: : And she's also going to need you to get onto the bed first so you can't try and see what she's hiding underneath her shirt.
lines.zh: : 而且她还需要你先上床，这样你就没法偷看她衣服底下藏着什么了。

lines.en: : You're being extremely unfair tonight.
lines.zh: : 你今晚非常不公平。

lines.en: : It's easier to put your foot down when your legs aren't being weighed down by pants.
lines.zh: : 腿上没有被裤子压着的时候，立场更容易坚定。

lines.en: : That is a yearbook quote if I've ever heard one.
lines.zh: : 这绝对可以当年鉴上的名言了。

lines.en: : Just shut up and get onto the bed, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 闭嘴上床，Sensei……

lines.en: scene black
I do as Chika says and lie down on the edge of her bed, making sure to give her enough room to get in behind me.
lines.zh: 我照 Chika 说的做，在她床边躺下，特意留出足够的位置让她躺在我身后。

lines.en: She runs over to the lights and switches them off before following suit and taking her place beside me.
lines.zh: 她跑过去把灯关掉，然后跟着躺下，在我身边占好位置。

lines.en: She reaches over me to grab the remote and put on whatever channel she's decided to watch tonight and, before I know it, she has her hand on my arm.
lines.zh: 她越过我去拿遥控器，调到她今晚决定要看的频道，而我还没反应过来，她的手已经搭在了我胳膊上。

lines.en: scene chikapjs6
: No looking over here at any point, got it?
lines.zh: : 任何时候都不许往这边看，明白吗？

lines.en: : Why am I allowed to watch you in the dressing room but not in the safety of your own bed?
lines.zh: : 为什么我在更衣室能看你，在你自己床上这么安全的地方反而不行？

lines.en: : You didn’t watch me get dressed, you just came in after. That's like, a totally different thing, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你又没看我穿衣服，你是之后才进来的。这完全是两码事，Sensei。

lines.en: : Besides, you’re gonna see me in lingerie soon anyway, so just hang on until then, kay?
lines.zh: : 再说，反正你很快就能看到我穿内衣的样子了，就先忍忍到那时候，好吗？

lines.en: : Soon? How soon?
lines.zh: : 很快？有多快？

lines.en: : I don't know. Sometime before you retire.
lines.zh: : 不知道哎。在你退休之前的某个时候吧。

lines.en: : Next week is actually my last. I have decided to leave the work force.
lines.zh: : 下周其实是我最后一周。我决定退出职场了。

lines.en: : Don't even joke about that. I don't want to imagine what life would be like with a normal teacher again.
lines.zh: : 这种事别开玩笑了。我可不想想象再换回一个普通老师的生活会是什么样。

lines.en: There are five girls on the TV in what appears to be some sort of reality show.
lines.zh: 电视上有五个女生，看起来像是在演某种真人秀。

lines.en: None of them seem to be aware that they're being filmed.
lines.zh: 她们似乎都没意识到自己正在被拍摄。

lines.en: : What are we watching right now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在在看什么？

lines.en: : Idunno. It just sorta came on in the middle of some other show I was watching. I don't really get it, but it looks kind of creepy so I kept it on.
lines.zh: : 不知道哎。它就这么插在我正在看的另一个节目中间播了出来。我也没太看懂，但看着挺瘆人的，所以就没换台。

lines.en: : Are you actually into stuff like this, Chika?
lines.zh: : 你真喜欢看这种东西吗，Chika？

lines.en: scene chikapjs7
: What, you mean like, horror?
lines.zh: : 什么，你是说恐怖片？

lines.en: : Horror. Thrillers. Whatever you want to call them.
lines.zh: : 恐怖片。惊悚片。随你怎么叫。

lines.en: : Mhm. Yumi and I used to watch stuff like this all the time when we first moved in.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我和 Yumi 刚搬进来的时候老看这种。

lines.en: : Did you know that she’s actually kind of a scaredy cat when it comes to movies?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，她看电影的时候其实胆子特别小？

lines.en: : Honestly, that doesn't really surprise me.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我一点都不意外。

lines.en: scene chikapjs8
: How about you, Sensei? Do you like stuff like this?
lines.zh: : 你呢，Sensei？你喜欢看这种吗？

lines.en: : Eh...I don't have much of an opinion. I’m fine with pretty much anything.
lines.zh: : 呃……我没什么特别的感觉。看什么都行。

lines.en: : Ami's terrified of stuff like this, though, so it's not something I really get to see all that often.
lines.zh: : 不过 Ami 特别怕这种东西，所以我也很少有机会看。

lines.en: scene chikapjs9
: What’s it like getting to live with Ami? Does she like, make you breakfast and stuff?
lines.zh: : 跟 Ami 住在一起是什么感觉？她会给你做早餐什么的吗？

lines.en: : Every morning. She’s pretty great at it too.
lines.zh: : 每天早上都做。而且她做得还挺好。

lines.en: : Really? I guess that doesn't surprise me.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？这我倒不意外。

lines.en: scene chikapjs10
: It’s a little embarrassing, but...I’m a pretty decent cook too, you know?
lines.zh: : 有点不好意思说啦，不过……我厨艺其实也挺好的，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Why is that embarrassing?
lines.zh: : 这有什么不好意思的？

lines.en: : Just cause it's like, one of those things no one really knows, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概就是那种没人知道的事吧，我猜。

lines.en: : Like I'm letting you see a part of me I haven't let anyone else see before.
lines.zh: : 就好像我在让你看一个我从没给别人看过的自己。

lines.en: scene chikapjs11
: I’ve...never really had a guy around that I could open up to, you know? Let alone one that I-
lines.zh: : 我……身边从来没有过能让我敞开心扉的男生，你懂吗？更别说一个我——

lines.en: : Uhh...
: One that you what?
lines.zh: : 一个你什么？

lines.en: : Respect.
lines.zh: : 尊敬的。

lines.en: A minute or two without any conversation passes by as the two of us fixate on the TV.
lines.zh: 我们俩盯着电视，一两分钟没人说话。

lines.en: The girls in the house become increasingly panicked as they begin to search for something.
lines.zh: 屋子里的女孩们开始找什么东西，变得越发慌张。

lines.en: I can’t really make out what any of them are saying over a loud buzzing noise coming from the speakers, but it looks like one of them might be crying.
lines.zh: 扬声器里传来很大的嗡嗡声，我听不清她们在说什么，但看样子其中一个可能在哭。

lines.en: It makes me feel incredibly uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 这让我浑身不自在。

lines.en: I have to focus on something else.
lines.zh: 我得把注意力转移到别处。

lines.en: : Have you really never had anyone like me to open up to before?
lines.zh: : 你以前真的从来没有过像我这样能让你敞开心扉的人吗？

lines.en: : What, you mean like, a guy?
lines.zh: : 什么，你是说男生？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Not really, no. My dad left when I was still really little.
lines.zh: : 没有，真没有。我爸在我很小的时候就走了。

lines.en: : It’s fine, though. I'm not really beat up over it. In fact, I think it's kind of better having no dad than one that treats you like shit.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。我也没为这事太难过。说实话，我觉得没爸爸，总比有个把你当垃圾看的爸爸要好。

lines.en: : I guess it did impact me in some way, though. Like, that’s probably why I told you I wanted someone dependable when you asked me what kind of guys I liked.
lines.zh: : 不过我想这事多少还是影响了我。比如，你问我喜欢什么类型的男生时，我说想要靠得住的人，大概就是因为这个。

lines.en: : I don’t want someone who’s just gonna up and leave me with a kid one day, you know?
lines.zh: : 我不想要那种有一天会突然丢下我和孩子一走了之的人，你懂吧？

lines.en: : You want kids?
lines.zh: : 你想要孩子？

lines.en: scene chikapjs10
: I think so. Babies are cute.
lines.zh: : 应该想吧。小宝宝多可爱啊。

lines.en: : I haven't really put much thought into it yet, though, so I guess my outlook could always change.
lines.zh: : 不过我还没认真想过这事，所以想法以后可能会变。

lines.en: : I've just got a little too much on my plate right now to worry about something like that.
lines.zh: : 我现在手头的事已经够多了，顾不上想那些。

lines.en: The show continues on.
lines.zh: 节目继续播着。

lines.en: There is something in the attic.
lines.zh: 阁楼里有什么东西。

lines.en: scene chikapjs11
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: scene chikapjs13
: Oh my- are you fucking kidding me right now?
lines.zh: : 我的天——你他妈在逗我吗？

lines.en: : You what?
lines.zh: : 你什么？

lines.en: : Nothing...Hold on just a sec.
lines.zh: : 没事……稍等一下。

lines.en: scene black
: Hello?
An urgent voice leaks out of the phone and oozes into Chika's ears.
lines.zh: 一个急促的声音从听筒里漏出来，钻进 Chika 的耳朵。

lines.en: I turn around to make sure that everything is okay and take notice of the sudden change of color in her eyes.
lines.zh: 我转过身想确认没事，却注意到她眼神的颜色骤然变了。

lines.en: It all fades away.
lines.zh: 一切神色都褪了下去。

lines.en: : Okay...
: Okay, just calm down. I’ll head over right now.
lines.zh: : 好，别慌。我现在就过去。

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: See you soon...
lines.zh: : 待会儿见……

lines.en: scene chikapjs14
Chika gets off of the bed and I follow her to the door. I already know what she’s about to say.
lines.zh: Chika 下了床，我跟她走到门口。我已经知道她要说什么了。

lines.en: : I’m really sorry, but I have to go...
lines.zh: : 真的很抱歉，我得走了……

lines.en: : No need to apologize. Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 不用道歉。一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Yeah, I think so...
lines.zh: : 嗯。嗯，应该还好……

lines.en: : Everything will be fine. I just have some stuff I need to do.
lines.zh: : 一切都会没事的。我只是有些事要去处理。

lines.en: : Do you...want me to come with you?
lines.zh: : 你……要我陪你去吗？

lines.en: scene chikapjs15
: Sensei...It’s the middle of the night. I’m not gonna make you come all the way across town with me...
lines.zh: : Sensei……现在是半夜。我不能让你大半夜陪我横穿整座城市……

lines.en: All the way across town? What exactly does Chika need to do at this hour?
lines.zh: 横穿整座城市？Chika 这个点到底要去做什么？

lines.en: There's no way I can just leave her alone for something as serious as this.
lines.zh: 这种事这么严重，我不可能放她一个人去。

lines.en: : And I’m not going to let you travel that far without someone to look after you.
lines.zh: : 我也不会让你一个人跑那么远，身边没人照应。

lines.en: : I do it all the time, Sensei. It’s fine. Really.
lines.zh: : 我常这样啊，Sensei。真的没事的。

lines.en: : This isn't something I'm going to back down from, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 可惜这件事我不会让步。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Just hurry up and get dressed. Whatever that call was sounded urgent.
lines.zh: : 快点去换衣服吧。那个电话听起来很急。

lines.en: : ...Okay.
: Just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: scene chikapjs14
: Look away first?...
lines.zh: : 先转过去好吗？……

And so I find myself back in the second half of town.
lines.zh: 于是我又回到了城市的另一半。

lines.en: The one filled with dilapidated buildings and feelings I've since forgotten.
lines.zh: 那一半遍布破败的楼房，还有我早已忘却的感觉。

lines.en: This is where I kissed Yumi.
lines.zh: 我就是在这一带吻了 Yumi。

lines.en: I thought about [raping] her that day.
lines.zh: 那天我想过[强暴]她。

lines.zh: 我想过她那未经润滑的处子之身，想过如果我未经邀请就进去，会给我们两人带来怎样的痛楚。

lines.en: I thought about [raping] her that day.
lines.zh: 那天我想过[强暴]她。

lines.en: I didn't do it, but I thought about it.
lines.zh: 我没做，但我想过。

lines.en: She'd probably get wet within a matter of minutes. She can't hide it from me.
lines.zh: 大概不出几分钟她就会湿了。这种事她瞒不过我。

lines.en: I didn't do it, but I thought about it.
lines.zh: 我没做，但我想过。

lines.en: Because I’m a good person.
lines.zh: 因为我是个好人。

lines.en: I stole her first kiss.
lines.zh: 我偷走了她的初吻。

lines.en: Everyone wins.
lines.zh: 皆大欢喜。

lines.en: I came so hard that night.
lines.zh: 那晚我射得痛快极了。

lines.en: The dry friction of the bedsheets wrapped around my cock still stings to this day.
lines.zh: 床单裹着我的鸡巴干磨的那种刺痛，到今天还隐隐作痛。

lines.en: Tonight, I will have more thoughts.
lines.zh: 今晚，我会有更多的念头。

lines.en: I wonder what will come of them.
lines.zh: 不知道它们会结出什么果。

lines.en: else:
Chika brings me to a place I haven’t seen before.
lines.zh: Chika 把我带到一个我从没见过的地方。

lines.en: It’s another half of Kumon-mi, much more run-down than the one I’m used to.
lines.zh: 这是 Kumon-mi 的另一半，比我熟悉的那半边破败得多。

lines.en: It’s filled with dilapidated buildings and riddled with homeless people.
lines.zh: 这里满是破旧的楼房，到处是无家可归的人。

lines.en: They cling to the sides of the streets like flies on a tape-trap.
lines.zh: 他们贴着街道两侧，像粘蝇板上的苍蝇。

lines.en: I’m glad I came with her tonight.
lines.zh: 我很庆幸今晚跟她一起来了。

lines.en: These people could have done horrible things to her.
lines.zh: 这些人本来可能对她做出可怕的事。

lines.en: The same sorts of things I dream to one day do.
lines.zh: 跟我梦想着有朝一日要做的那些事，是同一类。

lines.en: But I will have her trust- which is more than flies could ever hold.
lines.zh: 但我会得到她的信任——这是苍蝇们永远得不到的。

lines.en: I am the only person allowed to do horrible things to this girl.
lines.zh: 我是唯一被允许对这个女孩做那些可怕事情的人。

lines.en: I will take her virginity and hang it on the walls of my hippocampus as if it is some sort of trophy.
lines.zh: 我会夺走她的初夜，把它挂在我海马体的墙上，当作某种战利品。

lines.en: : Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...Just worried. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 嗯……只是担心。就这样。

lines.en: : Thanks for coming with me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你陪我来，Sensei。

lines.en: : Even though I do it all the time...I really don’t like walking around here alone at night.
lines.zh: : 虽然我常一个人走……但我真的不喜欢晚上独自在这边晃。

lines.en: : I...kinda had a feeling you’d come no matter how much I refused, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我……有种感觉，不管我怎么拒绝你都会来。

lines.en: : We’re...getting pretty close, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们……越来越亲近了，对吧？

lines.en: : You might have to learn some things about me.
lines.zh: : 你可能得了解一些关于我的事。

lines.en: : What sorts of things?
lines.zh: : 什么样的事？

lines.en: : Nothing bad. Just...depressing or whatever.
lines.zh: : 不是什么坏事。就是……让人沮丧之类的。

lines.en: : I’m sure I don’t have to tell you this but...please, please don’t tell anyone about tonight, okay?
lines.zh: : 我肯定不用多说，但……拜托，拜托千万别告诉任何人今晚的事，好吗？

lines.en: : I don’t even want to think about what would happen if the[school] found out.
lines.zh: : 我连想都不敢想，要是[学校]知道了会怎样。

lines.en: For some reason, words suddenly have a hard time crawling out of my throat.
lines.zh: 不知为何，话突然很难从我的喉咙里爬出来。

lines.en: The air in this half of town is remarkably thick.
lines.zh: 这一半城市的空气异常黏稠。

lines.en: It makes me think and say things I normally wouldn’t. Things that get stuck.
lines.zh: 它让我思考、说出一些平常不会说的话。一些卡在心里的话。

lines.en: This is a side event. I can’t make any mistakes here or Chika's affection level won’t rise and I won't be able to cum inside of her.
lines.zh: 这是支线事件。我不能在这儿出错，否则 Chika 的好感度不会上升，我也就没法射在她里面。

lines.en: : Can you at least tell me what's going on?
lines.zh: : 你至少能告诉我发生了什么吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe. I don't know. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许吧。我不知道。就是……

lines.en: : It's weird to talk about. Like, I know it’s just gonna shock you and make you think I’m biting off more than I can chew or something.
lines.zh: : 这事说出来挺奇怪的。我知道它只会吓到你，让你觉得我在自不量力什么的。

lines.en: : But...I can handle it.
lines.zh: : 但……我扛得住。

lines.en: : Really.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : Life sucks, I guess.
lines.zh: : 生活就是这么操蛋吧，我想。

lines.en: I am glad she learned early.
lines.zh: 我很庆幸她懂得早。

lines.en: It gives her time to break her nails while attempting to unearth the few things in life that can distract us from the underlying misery in all things.
lines.zh: 这样她就有时间，在试图挖出生命中少数能让我们不去想万物底层悲苦的东西时，把指甲折断。

lines.en: The things that make life better.
lines.zh: 那些让生活变好的东西。

lines.en: The things we can not speak of.
lines.zh: 那些我们无法言说的东西。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I’m here for you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，但有我在你身边。

lines.en: : And no matter what you’re hiding, I’ll help keep it a secret.
lines.zh: : 不管你在隐瞒什么，我都会帮你守住秘密。

lines.en: : Thank you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……

lines.en: : That really does make me feel a lot better.
lines.zh: : 这真的让我好受多了。

lines.en: Chika suddenly stops in front of a rundown apartment building.
lines.zh: Chika 突然在一栋破旧的公寓楼前停下。

lines.en: scene chikapjs19r
She looks lovely in the moonlight.
lines.zh: 月光下的她看起来很美。

lines.en: scene chikapjs19
: This is far enough.
lines.zh: : 送到这儿就行了。

lines.en: : Thanks again for coming with me, Sensei. Really.
lines.zh: : 再次谢谢你陪我来，Sensei。真的。

lines.en: : I might not be in[school] for the next few days, so just give any of my homework or handouts or whatever to Yumi.
lines.zh: : 接下来几天我可能不[上学]，我的作业、讲义什么的都交给 Yumi 就行。

lines.en: : If...she shows up, that is.
lines.zh: : 如果……她去上课的话。

lines.en: : Will do. Feel free to let me know if you need anything.
lines.zh: : 我会的。有什么需要尽管告诉我。

lines.en: : I will.
lines.zh: : 我会的。

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: scene chikapjs19r
scene chikapjs19
scene chikapjs19r
scene chikapjs20
: There’s something else I wanna do before I go, too.
lines.zh: : 走之前我还想做一件事。

lines.en: : What’s that?
lines.zh: : 什么事？

lines.en: : I want to kiss you.
lines.zh: : 我想吻你。

lines.en: : It’s okay, right?...I mean, it's pretty obvious we like each other.
lines.zh: : 可以吧？……我是说，明眼人都看得出我们互相喜欢。

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be in a hurry?
lines.zh: : 你不是赶时间吗？

lines.en: : Kissing doesn’t take long.
lines.zh: : 接吻又不花时间。

lines.en: : Well, you're right about that. But it still doesn't really seem like the time-
lines.zh: : 这倒是。但看起来还是不太是时候——

lines.en: : Can I, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 可以吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Can we kiss?
lines.zh: : 我们能接吻吗？

lines.zh: 我们温柔地吻了七秒钟。

lines.en: There is no tongue involved.
lines.zh: 没有伸舌头。

lines.zh: 之后不久我就回家了。
